profile.name: Claudiu Șpan
profile.headline: Applied AI & Automation Engineer
profile.summary: Applied AI & Automation Engineer delivering production workflows that connect enterprise business systems, validated LLM agents, and human-in-the-loop review. Combining 40+ end-to-end automation deliveries at Betfair Romania Development with cyber-physical systems engineering and autonomous drone perception as a technical side venture.

metrics.label: Production automation workflows delivered end to end
Reduction in operator data-review time via Agentic AI
Verified technical certifications across AI, AWS, Python & RPA

highlights.text: Delivered 40+ distinct automation workflows end to end: stakeholder discovery, AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, solution architecture, implementation, and production hypercare.

Architected an enterprise Agentic AI & human-in-the-loop review system combining UiPath Studio Web, Maestro orchestration, RPA processes, and validated LLM agent prompts — reducing operator verification time by approximately 70% while keeping PII strictly inside the enterprise boundary.

Built and optimized Python-based automation workflows and REST API / JSON data pipelines integrating Salesforce, Amazon Redshift, and internal risk systems with structured logging, error handling, and CI/CD deployments.

experience.role: Co-Founder — Autonomy & Computer Vision (Technical Side Venture)

highlights.text: Designed AI-powered drone autonomy pipelines combining ORB-SLAM3 and Depth Anything V2 for real-time monocular spatial perception.
Implemented real-time obstacle detection via point-cloud clustering and computer vision in a hybrid C++/Python architecture.
Built a multi-channel drone communication stack integrating ROS 2, GSM, and IP telemetry with automatic fallback logic and modular Python signal-monitoring services.
